CODES: DAILYCUP, GOLDHINATA, NEKOMAROUTE, INARIZAKI

🏐 BUILD A HAIKYUU SQUAD! 🏐

Roll for powerful volleyball players and build your ultimate six-player roster!

🌟 Collect 130+ characters and variants
🏫 Discover players from iconic schools and teams
⏳ Unlock rare timeskip, professional, and national-team cards
✨ Find legendary, mythic, and shiny variants
📈 Build the highest-overall squad possible
⚔️ Challenge other players in five-minute duels
🎁 Claim daily login and playtime rewards
💰 Earn coins, rerolls, and refreshes
🎯 Complete quests and redeem codes

This is an unofficial fan-made project. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the creators, publishers, or rights holders of Haikyuu. All related characters and properties belong to their respective owners.
